propositions: BindingRepository lifecycle alerts omit timestamp_ns when building the record, causing alert_store.is_deduped to default ts to 0 and fail the 24h dedup window check every pass
Alerts are appended without timestamp_ns from multiple call sites, not just BindingRepository, allowing duplicate records to accumulate indefinitely in the local bridge_alerts JSONL log
The dedup suppression window never fires because now - 0 vastly exceeds the 24h window, so identical alert keys are re-appended on every pass rather than suppressed
Records already on disk without timestamp_ns must remain readable without throwing when checked by is_deduped
Central stamping of timestamp_ns in alert_store.append at write time eliminates the class of unstamped-record bugs across all callers more safely than patching individual call sites
